content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Primarily an electric utility; its telecom arm is secondary, unlike ATN's connectivity-led business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells billing and network software and outsourced IT services to operators, not connectivity services to end users."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone and web hosting for small businesses, with no owned wireless or rural network operations."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Alaska wireless, broadband, and enterprise and government connectivity over its own networks, mirroring ATN's rural model."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Designs and sells communications hardware and software to carriers; it does not operate subscriber networks."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Subscription cloud communications software for businesses, not a network-operating connectivity provider."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Rural broadband, voice and business network services sold to households and businesses over its own network."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Rural and midsize wireless plus wireline broadband and voice, with own networks, stores and business connectivity."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Mainly leases fiber and copper capacity to carriers under long-term contracts; retail broadband is a small add-on."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Satellite broadband and defense electronics; it relies on satellite fleets and manufactures terminals rather than terrestrial networks."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Sells network test instruments, optical security materials and components; it is an equipment maker, not a service provider."}]}
